# mci-mail-reader test fixtures

All fixtures here are **synthesized at test time** with fake names and
redacted bodies — NO real user mail content has been imported. The
`integration.rs` test programmatically materializes each fixture into a
`tempfile::tempdir()` so the repo carries the generator, not the
generated bytes.

Per the V2-P8a dispatch (and ADR-0030 §3(e) default-deny posture):

- Real user mail content MUST NEVER appear in this directory or in any
  test under `mci-mail-reader/`.
- Any fixture that needs sender / recipient / subject / body content
  uses obviously-synthetic values: `alice@example.com`, `bob@example.com`,
  `"synthesized fixture"`, `"hello body."` and similar.
- Fixtures stay in-process; nothing is written outside `tempfile::tempdir()`.
